newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD APPROVED CLOSED ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD APPROVED CLOSED ISSUE.

text.p: The Riga Shipyard board has approved its second closed issue of 500,000 shares in December of 1996 with a nominal value of one lat, the Riga stock exchange said on Monday.
This has been performed in accordance to the sell-off regulations of the privatisation agency and the controlling stake purchase agreement, the bourse said in a statement.
Remar-Riga, which holds a 45 percent stake in the shipyard, has the sole right to subscribe to the closed issue.
Riga Shipyard was listed as an official list stock on the Riga bourse this week.
The company's basic capital is 10 million lats and its balance sheet total is 10.89 million lats.
